title: D.A. in Cornell Case Hopes to Speak to Accuser as He Weighs New Evidence
summary: District Attorney Matthew Van Houten said a woman’s report to police in 2024 saying she had been raped at a fraternity did not support a criminal case. But he said he is now reaching out to her.
